title: Power board: +20 V buck
comments: TPS54560 buck, 24 V to +20 V at 2 A, synced to CLK_A (about 400 kHz; RT alone gives 400 kHz)
UVLO start 21.1 V, stop 18.7 V: waits for the input soft start (design.py)
Feedback before the LC filter; 2.2 uH + 330 uF polymer + 100 uF damping, about 47 dB at 400 kHz
